title: Ferry Times
intro: Ahoy! The ferry always leaves on time. The trouble is, nobody knows when that is.
My timetable is in your code. Give it a “Where to?” field, and list only the ferries going where the passenger typed.
If no ferry goes there, say “No ferry goes there”. And sailors never bother with capital letters!
My sketch is up on the sign board. Press Run whenever you want me to take a look!
celebration: Coral Island at eight, and no ferry to the moon. Now everyone knows!
thanks: All aboard! Iara's Ferry is open, and Main Street is complete.
request: Can you make my timetable? Add a "Where to?" field, and list only the departures whose destination contains what was typed, capital letters or not. When nothing matches, say "No ferry goes there".

criteria.message: Passengers need somewhere to type where they're going.

criteria.description: Every departure is listed before anyone types
"No ferry goes there" stays hidden while ferries are listed
criteria.message: Don't scare my passengers! There are plenty of ferries.

criteria.description: Typing "coral" lists only the Coral Island ferries
criteria.message: Someone typed “coral”. Capital letters or not, they want Coral Island and nothing else!

criteria.description: Typing "Moon Bay" says "No ferry goes there"
criteria.message: No ferry goes to Moon Bay. Tell them, or they'll wait on the pier all day!
